headline: Gold Rush in Gopher Country. Zero Fox Given Rides Out 0 for 11.
deck: Phil swept the all-play, Eshan rode a lucky horse to 9-2, and Sagar never left the saloon: zero moves, zero all-play wins, 9-2 loss.
lead: Gopher Gold beat every team in the league on paper, all 11 of them, and Domantas Sabonis shot 21 for 26 doing it. BrookynDynasty drew the short straw and lost 8-3 to the only team it couldn't beat.

At the other end of Main Street, Zero Fox Given beat nobody. Not one team in all-play, a 9-2 loss to Acinonyx, and not a single roster move all week. Luka Dončić hung 52 on them Sunday just to make sure the body stayed down.

Defending champ Thug Life opened the title defense with a 6-5 loss to LeParth James, who won the week with three players on the floor Sunday. Mikal Bridges went 0 for 10 from three. The belt is already loose.

MONSTARS ☄️ flipped it to 7-4 on Saturday behind Jalen Johnson and Ty Jerome, who went 14 for 14 at the line over the weekend. Then Sunday came: Scottie Barnes went 0 for 12, the lead bled out, and Chris settled for a 5-5-1 tie with Cooper Flagg sitting in his opponent's IL slot.
late.web.l.39751.t.7|web.l.39751.t.10: Nova Knicks led 9-2 through Friday and coasted. White Mambas got 42 points and 8 threes from Jamal Murray over the weekend and stole back DREB and AST. Too little, too late, and Vishal still made zero moves to help it.
late.web.l.39751.t.1|web.l.39751.t.12: theInfamous was down 9-2 Friday and clawed back one category. Anthony Black hit 5 of 7 from three over the weekend. It was still an 8-3 burial.
late.web.l.39751.t.2|web.l.39751.t.11: Acinonyx was already up 8-2-1. Luka's 52 on Sunday just added BLK to the pile.

boot: Cooper Flagg ($43) played twice and went to the IL. Stephen Curry ($31) sat on John J's bench Saturday and is on IL now. Kon Knueppel ($21) never left Thug Life's IL slot all week. Jalen Duren, Paolo Banchero and Joel Embiid all landed there Sunday.
roy: The board doesn't care about Week 1. White Mambas went 4-7 and Yahoo's projections rank the roster first the rest of the way. Gopher Gold swept the all-play, owns a near lock on the playoffs, and projects ninth. Zero Fox Given projects last, which tracks.

zingers.web.l.39751.t.1: John J made 7 moves and still got shot 8-3. Darius Acuff Jr. went 24 for 73. That's not a rookie, that's a firing squad.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.2: Eshan went 9-2 on a roster the all-play math calls a .612 team. Luka dropped 52 Sunday. Nikola Vučević started once and scored 0. Enjoy the stolen horse.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.3: Adarsh beat 7 of 11 teams and lost 8-3 because he drew the Sheriff. AJ Dybantsa and Jimmy Butler III spent the whole week in the IL slot collecting dust.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.4: Phil swept the all-play 11-0 and Sabonis shot 21 for 26. Hold the parade: Yahoo's rest-of-season projections rank this roster ninth.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.5: Chris trailed 6-5 Friday, led 7-4 Saturday, and tied 5-5-1 Sunday. Two moves all week. Jalen Green went 9 for 22 and Jalen Duren is on IL.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.6: Parth beat the defending champ 6-5 with three players on the floor Sunday. De'Anthony Melton started and scored 0. Joel Embiid is back in the IL slot, right where he left it.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.7: Roshan won 7-4, then added Noah Clowney, Scotty Pippen Jr. and De'Andre Hunter inside three minutes Sunday night. That's not a waiver strategy, that's a bar fight.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.8: Keshav paid $43 for Cooper Flagg. Flagg played twice and hit the IL. Keshav still clawed back from 7-4 down Saturday to a tie, which is the most work anyone on this team did.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.9: The defending champ opened with a 6-5 loss. Mikal Bridges went 5 for 23 and 0 for 10 from three. Kon Knueppel ($21) never left the IL slot. The belt is on loan.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.10: Vishal made zero moves and lost 7-4. Josh Giddey ($35) shot 7 for 26. The scary part: Yahoo projects this roster first the rest of the way, so he'll call it a plan.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.11: Sagar beat zero of 11 teams, lost 9-2 and made zero moves. The only thing moving in that saloon is the tumbleweed.
zingers.web.l.39751.t.12: Jason won 8-3 and Shai went 32 for 72. The luck meter says this is a .599 team wearing a .727 hat. Enjoy it while the hat fits.
